error.message: Storage or output I/O prevented completion.

remediation.summary: The VSift session_root folder's permissions no longer include your own account, so VSift cannot open it and changed nothing. Only SYSTEM and Administrators keep access: earlier versions of VSift could leave a new session folder like this on Windows when several commands used it for the first time at once. It is the disposable-session folder: the directory given with --session-root, or VSift-sessions under LOCALAPPDATA. To use it again, give your account its access back from a Command Prompt, with that folder's path: icacls "<folder>" /grant "%USERDOMAIN%\%USERNAME%:(OI)(CI)F". Or, as sessions are disposable, delete the folder (if Windows refuses, run the same icacls command first) and retry; VSift creates it again, private to you. VSift does not change the folder's permissions itself.
